headline.purpose: Screen, panel, and procedure headings that carry hierarchy without ornament.

body.purpose: Explanatory chemistry content, reading, and dense operational detail.

utility.purpose: Manual references, metadata, chips, table values, and secondary actions.

eyebrow.purpose: Uppercase course and context signals above a primary heading.

shadows.name: ambient-lift
shadows.purpose: Restrained navy-tinted separation for the fixed rail, primary cards, and guided walkthrough surfaces.

shadows.name: control-lift
shadows.purpose: Small active-control elevation; never a substitute for content hierarchy.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.value: color and opacity transitions; progress bars use 500ms ease-out
motion.purpose: Communicate state change and guided-procedure progress without decorative movement.

motion.name: reduced-motion-equivalent
motion.purpose: Suppresses nonessential transitions and rehearsal effects while leaving persistent status cues visible.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive forward action for a procedure or preparation task.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: var(--rounded-control, 0.5rem); background: var(--primary-container, #001f3f); color: var(--on-primary, #ffffff); padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; font: 700 0.875rem/1.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--secondary, #705d00); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A secondary navigation or reversible action that remains quieter than the forward path.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { border: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #c4c6cf); border-radius: var(--rounded-control, 0.5rem); background: var(--surface-container-lowest, #ffffff); color: var(--on-surface-variant, #43474e); padding: 0.625rem 1rem; font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--surface-container-low, #f3f4f5); border-color: var(--secondary, #705d00); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--secondary, #705d00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Study Card
components.description: A quiet, bounded reading or working surface for a module, worksheet, or dashboard region.
components.html:
MODUL AKTIF

Reaksi Golongan Utama

Ringkasan keputusan dan bukti belajar berada di permukaan yang tenang.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--outline-variant, #c4c6cf) 30%, transparent); border-radius: var(--rounded-card, 0.75rem); background: var(--surface-container-lowest, #ffffff); color: var(--on-surface, #191c1d); padding: 1.5rem; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 31, 63, 0.08); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-kicker { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; color: var(--secondary, #705d00); font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; color: var(--primary, #000613); font: 700 1.25rem/1.5rem Montserrat, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card p:not(.ds-card-kicker) { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #43474e); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Safety Callout
components.description: A left-ruled, text-first warning that keeps approved safety wording visible at the decision point.
components.html:
Keselamatan

Ikuti SOP/SDS yang disetujui dan konfirmasi dengan asisten sebelum melanjutkan.
components.css: .ds-safety { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--error, #ba1a1a) 35%, transparent); border-left: 4px solid var(--error, #ba1a1a); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--error-container, #ffdad6) 30%, transparent); color: var(--on-surface, #191c1d); padding: 0.75rem; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-safety strong { color: var(--error, #ba1a1a); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-safety p { margin: 0.35rem 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact state metadata for active, scheduled, safety, or verified learning status.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--surface-variant, #e1e3e4); color: var(--on-surface-variant, #43474e); padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; font: 500 0.75rem/1rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 0.375rem; height: 0.375rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--secondary, #705d00); }

components.name: Procedure Progress
components.description: The signature instructional progress pattern: a labeled stage, gold completion bar, and visible current-step context.
components.css: .ds-progress { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-progress-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #43474e); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-progress-label strong { color: var(--secondary, #705d00); } .ds-progress-track { height: 0.5rem; margin-top: 0.5rem; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--surface-container-high, #e7e8e9); } .ds-progress-track span { display: block; width: 40%; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--secondary-container, #fcd400); transition: width 500ms ease-out; }

narrative.overview: KUGU Lab makes pre-lab preparation feel like working through a precise, calm laboratory record beside a purposeful instrument panel. The interface supports repeated study and procedural decision-making: dense enough to retain meaningful chemistry context, yet disciplined enough that the next action, safety status, and evidence remain scannable. Midnight Bench Navy establishes the controlled laboratory frame; Safety Signal Gold is the visible cue for action, progression, and attention. Soft paper-like grays keep long study sessions quiet, while gentle ambient lift separates operational surfaces without turning the application into a glossy dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Calm academic precision over marketing or gamification.
Operational hierarchy: task, status, evidence, then secondary reference material.
Safety cues are explicit, local to the decision, and never merely decorative.
Rounded, low-contrast containers support dense study material without visual noise.
Motion communicates progress or a physical laboratory phenomenon and always has a reduced-motion equivalent.

rules.name: The Signal-Not-Decoration Rule
rules.body: Gold signals a meaningful action, active state, progress marker, or safety-relevant emphasis. Do not scatter it across neutral cards for decoration.

rules.name: The Safety Has a Voice Rule
rules.body: Danger and warning colors must arrive with clear text, an icon or label, and an actionable boundary; color alone never carries the meaning.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Montserrat only for hierarchy-bearing headings and short emphasis. Use Inter for everything that must be read, compared, entered, or acted on.

rules.name: The Paper-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with surface tone and outline first. Add ambient shadow only when a surface truly needs elevation or interaction emphasis.

dos: Do use Midnight Bench Navy to establish the application frame and Safety Signal Gold to indicate meaningful action or progression.
Do use Montserrat for short hierarchy and Inter for instructional, data-heavy, or interactive copy.
Do keep cards quiet: white or cool-gray surfaces, soft outlines, and ambient navy lift only where hierarchy demands it.
Do pair every safety, correctness, and progress color with readable text and a semantic control or live-status treatment.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and the existing reduced-motion fallback for every animated or interactive state.
donts: Don't turn the system into a marketing hero, a game reward layer, or an analytics dashboard full of decorative metrics.
Don't use gold as a generic accent on every card, or use red/green without an explicit safety or verification meaning.
Don't replace the two-font hierarchy with display-heavy or novelty typography.
Don't use hard black shadows, high-gloss glass panels, or unbounded animation to create false importance.
Don't let a digital completion state imply independent authorization for physical laboratory work.
